ground_truth_rule: Rows are research labels for preflight design. Before S16B implementation they must be independently Oracle/CR rechecked against a pinned corpus and adjudicated without looking at candidate S16B outputs. Current S9 output was not used to choose or change a relevance label.

relation_labels.STRONG_FUNCTIONAL: substantially the same context-free gameplay job with materially different mechanics or delivery
relation_labels.CONTEXTUAL_FUNCTIONAL: same gameplay job only under an explicit deck/game/archetype context
relation_labels.PARTIAL_ROLE: shares an important parent job but differs enough that replacement/equivalence is unsafe
relation_labels.HARD_NEGATIVE: surface/mechanical/vocabulary overlap is insufficient for the proposed job
relation_labels.VOCABULARY_CONFLICT: community label boundary itself is disputed; must not be forced into binary truth

positive_rows.label: STRONG_FUNCTIONAL
positive_rows.context: context-free functional parent; especially combo/proactive-turn protection
positive_rows.mechanical_difference: hard prohibition on spells plus specified activated abilities versus a three-mana out-of-turn spell tax that also applies symmetrically by turn controller

positive_rows.confidence: MEDIUM_HIGH; direct-comparison sources likely share some primer lineage
